method.fixtures: Synthetic legal gym access, 10,000 test coupons, 25 template entries and synthetic historical legend records for achievements. Not evidence of acquisition difficulty.
method.invariants: Input immutability, refused-operation atomicity, exact cash deltas, valid saves, capacity/family/XP limits, same-player nonnegative growth, serialization round trips.
method.offline: Exact event dispatch versus real offline replay; arbitrary segmentation is tested only within one cap. Selection order must not alter individual RNG allocation.
method.concurrency: Two stores share one memory-backed storage object, exercising the existing shared writer queue. Existing browser Web Locks/IndexedDB tests remain separate.
method.performance: Node24 single-process wall timings on this host, 5 runs except 3 offline runs; not mobile/browser latency. Histories are structurally valid synthetic records. Main and backup are full envelopes.
method.quota: Explicit simulated 5MiB UTF16 key/value budget; this is a stress fixture, not a claim about the user browser quota.
